user.title: Add a camera
user.description: Choose bridge discovery or manual entry.

manual.title: Enter an address
manual.description: Enter a display name and IPv4 address. The integration creates a unique stream and asks the bridge to start it.

discovery.title: Discover cameras
discovery.description: Leave unchecked to retry, or check to enter an address manually.

select.title: Select a camera
select.description: Choose an address and name, or check manual entry.

error.invalid_input: Invalid IPv4 address or display name.
error.discovery_failed: Discovery failed or the bridge is unavailable.

init.title: Change camera address
init.description: The bridge will stop the old stream and start one for this address.

error.bridge_unavailable: Netvue Bridge is unavailable; the address was not changed.
